title: Wave C: the ICAR system — the 4 ICAR deemed universities (G5) and NAARM (G3)

institutes.name: Indian Agricultural Research Institute
institutes.reference_id: ICAR deemed universities: IARI, New Delhi
institutes.notes: Also known as Pusa Institute. Its outreach campuses (IARI Jharkhand, IARI Assam) are not loaded separately.
institutes.statutory_basis: ICAR institute, Institution Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act

institutes.name: National Dairy Research Institute
institutes.notes: Runs B.Tech Dairy Technology at Karnal; regional stations at Bengaluru and Kalyani are not loaded separately.
institutes.statutory_basis: ICAR institute, Institution Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act

institutes.name: Indian Veterinary Research Institute
institutes.notes: Campus at Izatnagar, Bareilly; runs B.V.Sc. & A.H.
institutes.statutory_basis: ICAR institute, Institution Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act

institutes.name: Central Institute of Fisheries Education
nirf_names: Central Institute of Fisheries Education, Fisheries University
institutes.statutory_basis: ICAR institute, Institution Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act

institutes.name: National Academy of Agricultural Research Management
nirf_names: ICAR-National Academy of Agricultural Research Management (NAARM)
institutes.statutory_basis: ICAR institute (Indian Council of Agricultural Research, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare)
institutes.notes: Admits students to its PGDM (Agri-Business Management). Other ICAR research institutes teach only through the ICAR deemed universities and are not listed.
